raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner changed the counting criteria mid-task to “only blue-linked members” and included touring members for Screaming Trees while omitting core non–blue-linked members for Letters to Cleo (e.g., Greg McKenna). They also introduced incorrect/hallucinated Screaming Trees names (e.g., Donna Dresch), ignored their earlier, larger Letters to Cleo count, and thus concluded incorrectly that Screaming Trees had more members.
